message: Welcome back, Maya. Last time you were weighing $200K into the SpaceX IPO — your deadline is Sunday, June 15. Want to pick up where we left off, or look at something else?

basedOn.fact: Considering a $200K allocation to the SpaceX IPO, decision deadline around June 15
basedOn.source_quote: I want to put $200K into the SpaceX IPO. I have about 6 days to decide.

suggested: What changed since I was last here?
Where did we land on the SpaceX IPO?
Am I on track for the lake house?
